discoveredComplexity: Two trees planned the same lane at once. Between 19:48Z and 19:59Z this issue's spec gained the pmdoc and api jobs, the architect answered twice on how to size them, and the work was built here; meanwhile sjawhar/legion#2517 had already built both with better numbers, each package measured alone (pmdoc 1023.5 s against 1210.064 s when it shares the step, api 746.7 s against 871.539 s). The cost was one implementing round in this tree. The signal that would have caught it earlier is the sibling pull request itself: before building a lane change, read what the other tree's open pull request already has in it.

The architect's first form of acceptance 5 named internal/dispatch as a package; it is a directory of 30 subpackages with no Go file of its own, and the timeout the spec's evidence cites was the docs package again, which the panic's own stack names (docs.TestMain through storetest.Main). Reading the stack rather than the package line is what told the two apart.
